Wand of Fireball.Description: Spell DC 10. Range 10". AOE 3" diameter mishap rolls.
Wand of Fireball.About: A powerful wand that unleashes explosive fireballs.

Cloak of Elvenkind.About: An enchanted cloak that grants supernatural agility.

Wand of Gust.Description: Spell DC 10. Range 15". AOE 3". Units get pushed away from the caster 5".
Wand of Gust.About: A wand that conjures powerful gusts of wind to reposition foes.

Boots of Haste.About: Enchanted boots that greatly increase the wearer's speed.

Mask of Madness.About: A cursed mask that grants terrible powers at a steep price.

Ethereal Robe.About: A ghostly robe that allows the wearer to phase through obstacles.

Holy Relic.Description: Opponent's Rout Threshold is lowered by 1.
Holy Relic.About: A sacred artifact that bolsters your warband's morale while breaking the enemy's will.

Wand of Polymorph.Description: Unit can Cast the following Spell: "Polymorph. Difficulty 15. 15". Ongoing. On a success, the target is turned into a Giant Rat, only retaining its current Wounds."
Wand of Polymorph.About: A dangerous wand that can transform enemies into harmless creatures.

Assassin Garb.Description: Armour. +1 Def. Add +5 on Out-of-Sight Rolls. Cannot be used with a Shield.
Assassin Garb.About: Dark clothing designed for stealth and protection.
Assassin Garb.Special: Add +5 on Out-of-Sight Rolls. Cannot be used with a Shield.

Giant Slayer.Description: Great Sword (2 handed). You have Advantage on Melee rolls against units with more than 1 max Wounds.
Giant Slayer.About: A legendary blade forged to fell the mightiest foes.
Giant Slayer.Special: Advantage on Melee rolls against units with more than 1 max Wounds.
